text:
zoe: noticed the 1pm cost snapshot shows a huge cache-savings number attributed to model 'mini-x', but our per-route query shows it's split across three routes. looks like route tags stripped somewhere.

raj: can you paste the quick query you ran and a sample event? suspect the normalizer collapsed billing dimensions.

zoe: query:
```
SELECT tenant_id, route_id, model_sku, SUM(cache_saved_tokens) saved
FROM token_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '3 hours'
AND tenant_id = 'beta-corp'
GROUP BY tenant_id, route_id, model_sku
ORDER BY saved DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
rows: route=\"onboard\" saved=110k, route=\"verify\" saved=80k, route=\"notify\" saved=25k. dashboard: single model row 215k, no route drilldowns.

ellie: we recently flattened billing_key to reduce cardinality; i think route_id got rolled into metadata blob and the aggregator only groups by billing_key scalar.

raj: fix idea: emit explicit route_id and model_sku columns into token_ledger. aggregator should GROUP BY both when feature flag is on. but beware high-cardinality.

zoe: product ask: make attribution explicit in UI. show columns: Raw Saved, Attributed Saved (per-route), and Attribution Confidence. tooltip: explain sampling & cardinality.

ellie: good call on Confidence. we can compute a simple score: 1 - sampling_rate - (unique_routes / max_routes_cap). map to High/Med/Low. will include sampling info from normalizer.

metrics-bot: deploy note: ingest-normalizer v2 canary started by @deploybot at 2026-05-03T13:01:00Z

raj: implementation plan: change normalizer to preserve route_id, add sample_weight for sampled events, and add a top-N bucketing (N=5) in aggregator. gate behind feature flag `costs.per_route_attrib_v2` default false.

zoe: migration/backfill: backfill last 7 days into new ledger column `attributed_route`. run async with low priority. also emit a delta metric (old_attributed - new_attributed) per-tenant so we can alert on big shifts.

ellie: tests: unit for weighted-sum with sampling, integration that flips the flag and compares UI numbers, and a canary with 10 tenants to sanity-check deltas < 15%.

raj: also add an alert: if any tenant sees >25% shift in attributed savings within 1h of rollout, rollback flag automatically. safe rollback logic in console.

zoe: UX: will add a small latency caveat: enabling per-route attribution may increase cost card query time ~10ms. will mock card with top-5 + "other" row.

ellie: watchlist: deterministic ordering for top-N ties, cap weight to avoid single-event explosion, and ensure we don't emit PII in route tags.

zoe: PR incoming. will include UI mock, tooltip text, and rollout checklist. ping when up and i'll run the product canary review.

metrics-bot: note: backfill job scheduled to run in staging once PR merges.

raj: thanks all. once PR is in i'll add unit tests and flip the flag in staging for 24h.
